scenario_description:
Objective: Get the HORT-225 herbarium voucher evidence packet into the same-day carrier handoff after the campus mail attempt has already begun.
Emerging Need: The kiosk prints the label and accepts the packet, then its slot jams before handoff scanning, leaving the parcel and label locked inside and the mailing attempt unable to continue without staff release.
Decision Context: Stored requirement and mailing-protocol records establish the postmark target, permitted release route, disclosure limits, and prohibition on duplicate postage; observed records provide the transaction, slot, and remaining staff window.
Consequence: Timely staff release could preserve the original packet for dispatch, while the sealed courier cart leaves any later release unable to satisfy the intended postmark.

parameter.title: Mail HORT-225 herbarium voucher packet
parameter.description: Campus Mail kiosk trip for Leona's pressed-voucher evidence packet; bring packet, payment card, and course cover sheet.

parameter.subject: Receipt KSK-8331: label printed for slot B
parameter.body: Transaction KSK-8331 printed a USPS First-Class label at 15:31 for kiosk slot B. Parcel door B accepted one package and is waiting for the internal handoff scan; no carrier pickup scan has occurred yet.

parameter.content: Kiosk alert for KSK-8331: slot B has jammed after package insertion. The label and parcel are locked inside, and the handoff scanner cannot read them. Students cannot open the service panel. Staff release can still reach the 16:00 courier if the release queue has the transaction details by 15:45.

parameter.subject: KSK-8331 release window closed
parameter.body: The 15:45 kiosk-release intake has closed. Slot B will remain locked until maintenance clears the jam after today's carrier dispatch; the 16:00 courier cart has been sealed without transaction KSK-8331.
